officialText:
The department may refuse to issue a certificate of occupancy for a building pending payment of all outstanding fees, fines or civil penalties imposed for violations of this code, the 1968 building code or other laws enforced by the department at the same building.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
